//: Emit-only project for the runtime bench (design/09 WS7). The bench is `.mjs` like bench/types, and Node cannot load `src/**/*.ts` directly because every import in the package carries the `.js` suffix ESM requires. So `run.mjs` builds the package once with the consumer-floor compiler (5.9.3) and imports the JavaScript a user would get. `test/live/fixture.ts` comes along because the bench measures the same tables the live suite does — a second fixture is a second thing that can drift (R5).
